releaseNotes: Sanetra v2.0.1 (versionCode 3) includes the verified Android APK installer handoff for cross-package migrations and release signing under com.sanetra.assistivevision. Legacy v1.0.0 (com.visionassistant.vision_assistant.visionmission) users must perform the first v2.x installation manually (Android installs it as a separate app alongside v1.0.0), while future compatible v2.x updates install in place.
